title: API: change with isTracked false returns 201 with is_tracked false and keeps Min, Max and bin quantities
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools (Network tab: copy the request the screen sent, edit, resend) against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Data: QAPL-T2 (tracked, with stock, Min and Max saved). Before the run note its Total Qty, Min, Max and each bin chip with its quantity. No DB access: values the handoff checks in the DB are verified through the API response, the UI and Part History instead.
custom_steps:
1. Open QAPL-T2 from /parts/inventory, change nothing and click Save; in the Network tab copy the POST /api/inventory/parts/change request.
  2. Resend it with "isTracked":false set (added if the dialog did not send it) and everything else unchanged (body shape: {"id":"<part>","categoryId":"<cat>","vendorId":…,"manufacturerId":…,"quantity":…,"gridLocation":…,"sellPrice":…,"purchasePrice":…,"coreCharge":…,"environmentalCharge":…,"tags":[…],"bins":[{"id":"<bin>","quantity":…,"isDefault":true}],"isFixedPrice":false,"isTracked":false}).
  3. Reload /parts/inventory and search QAPL-T2.
  4. Click the row's Part History icon.
  5. Cleanup: resend the request with "isTracked":true and reload the list.
custom_expected:
1. 201; the captured body carries the part's id, categoryId and bins (id, quantity, isDefault) as saved.
  2. 201 with data.is_tracked: false, and data.part_number "QAPL-T2" and data.name (its description) in the body.
  3. Total Qty reads "Not Tracked"; every bin chip shows the noted quantity; the Min and Max columns show the noted values (unchanged).
  4. Newest entry "Tracking turned off"; no "Min/Max updated" entry is written by this call.
  5. 201 with data.is_tracked: true; the row shows "{n} available" with the noted quantity and Min/Max unchanged.
